auth.lead: WBMC is not a public forum. Sign in with your account or register with an invitation code.
auth.mfaText: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

auth.registerText: You can only register with an invitation code issued by the club. After registration an administrator approves the account.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.text: A second sign-in step with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password). Required for administrators and club leadership.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
mfa.codesText: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose access to your phone. They will not be shown again.
mfa.disableText: Two-factor authentication can only be turned off by another authorised administrator after reviewing the request.
mfa.requiredText: Your role requires a second sign-in step. Turn it on before using administration features.
mfa.stepupText: Administration actions need a fresh code from your authenticator app.
gate.loginText: This section is available after signing in with a club account.
gate.pendingText: An administrator will review the registration and assign a role. After that this section becomes available.
gate.noAccessText: Your role has no rights to this section.

adm.rejectText: The account will be archived and cannot sign in.
adm.name: Name
adm.roleManual: Role changes are recorded in the audit log and security events.

adm.revokeText: The code can no longer be used.
adm.inviteShare: Give the code or link in person. The code is shown only in this list.
adm.auditText: Every administration action with time, actor and changes.

priv.data: The public pages can be used without an account. In the club area we process only the data the features need:
priv.d.account: Account: email, name or road name, a password hash (the password itself is never stored), role and status.
priv.d.security: Security: sign-in time, IP address, browser description, a device identifier, security events and audit entries.
priv.d.comms: Communication: messages, forum posts, ideas and orders in the club area.
priv.d.files: Files: images, documents and voice messages uploaded in the club area.
priv.d.location: Location: only when you share it yourself (the pack on the map, SOS). The pack location is not stored in the database.
priv.d.profiles: Member profiles and Memorials: only information approved by the club, with consent.
priv.d.local: In your browser: language choice, saved events, chess game and routes (localStorage), which you can delete at any time.
priv.purpose: Running and securing the club area (legitimate interests and the membership relationship) and meeting legal obligations. We do not sell data or use it for advertising.
priv.r.security: Security events and IP addresses — 90 days.
priv.r.sessions: Sessions — up to 30 days without activity, never longer than 90 days.
priv.r.account: Account and communication — while you are a club member; afterwards deleted or anonymised unless there is a legal reason to keep them longer.
priv.r.location: Pack location — real time only, not stored.
priv.r.backups: Database backups — encrypted, up to 30 days.
priv.cookies: We use only cookies needed for the site to work: a session cookie (wbmc_s, HttpOnly, after sign-in) and a device identifier for security (wbmc_d). No analytics or advertising cookies are used, so no consent banner is needed.
priv.third: The site uses Cloudflare (hosting and database, EU/US), OpenStreetMap maps, Open-Meteo weather, OSRM routing, Photon address search, Overpass points of interest and the RainViewer radar. Coordinates are sent for maps and weather, but not your account.
priv.consent: We publish photos, member profiles and Memorial cards only with the consent of the person or their family and the club's approval. Consent can be withdrawn at any time.
priv.rights: You have the right to access your data, correct it, request deletion or restrict processing, and to complain to the Latvian Data State Inspectorate (www.dvi.gov.lv). We handle requests within one month, taking legal obligations and the club's legitimate interests into account.
